new_local_details: Local functional writer/grower/custodian roles and bed IDs are original candidate details. Existing English letters, estimates, topology and version are unchanged.

paragraphs.en: At the living-area threshold, the local writer can invite this repairer to help with the current draft and its intended correspondence. The permission covers current_draft and correspondence_intent, recipient patrol_technician, purpose help_this_reply, and the exact original letter version. It gives access to the reply room and this letter only. It does not disclose a street address, promise a visit, grant public publication, or authorise unrelated testimony. The writer may withdraw this scope; the safe return door remains open.
paragraphs.zh: 居住区门口的当地作者可邀请本次检修人协助当前草稿与通信意图。许可只含 current_draft/correspondence_intent 两字段、接收方 patrol_technician、用途 help_this_reply 和原信精确版本，只开放回信房间与这封信。它不披露街道住址、不承诺见面、不准公开全文或调取其它证言。作者可撤回范围，安全返程门仍开放。

paragraphs.en: A revision keeps the invitation to correspond and excludes a visit promise or public street address. A short acknowledgement can travel through the local post custodian using the envelope's existing room code. After reading the current saved revision, the writer may approve that short acknowledgement or choose to keep the revision. The player's confirmation of meaning does not send a letter. An approval for an earlier draft cannot send a later one. Pausing keeps the same local work instance and creates no mainline restriction.
paragraphs.zh: 修订应保留通信邀请，排除来访承诺和公共街道住址。简短确认可经当地邮务保管人沿信封既有房间代码寄送。作者看过当前保存稿后，可批准这份短确认，或保留修订稿。玩家确认意思并未发送；旧稿许可不能发送新稿。暂缓保留同一地方工作实例，不增加主线限制。

paragraphs.en: The six existing trial beds are marked R2-TRIAL-BED-1 to R2-TRIAL-BED-6. Choose a crop for each bed at the allocation stand. A complete Leaf layout uses four quick-leaf beds and two storage-root beds; a complete Root layout uses two quick-leaf beds and four storage-root beds. The local grower checks those six actual spaces before approving a layout. A proposed revision can remain pending for agreement, but it cannot silently become an approved third arrangement. The same existing local tools are available; no personal or tower equipment is taken.
paragraphs.zh: 六个既有床位标记 R2-TRIAL-BED-1..6。在分配台逐床选作物。完整叶菜布局为四叶两根，完整根菜布局为两叶四根。当地种植者实际核对六处空间后批准布局。申请修改可暂待共识，但不会静默成为已批准第三方案。使用既有当地工具，不取玩家或灯塔装备。

paragraphs.en: After approval, carry out each bed's planting at this layout stand and retain its work record. A saved note, an approved plan, or planting only some beds is not a completed six-bed trial. The final note records the chosen complete layout and its early-serving versus later-storage trade-off. The original eight/four and four/eight basket figures remain conditional estimates. They are not a harvested stock, personal currency, or tower provision receipt. Both this planting work and the private reply award zero experience, marks and parts and never block the transfer investigation, recruitment or an ending.
paragraphs.zh: 批准后，在当前布局台逐床实际种植并保留工作记录。保存笔记、批准方案或只种一部分都不是六床试种完成。最终说明对应完整配置和较早供餐/较晚储藏取舍。原件八/四及四/八筐仍为条件估算，不是收成库存、个人货币或塔站保障回执。种植与回信均零经验、刻币、零件，不阻断转移调查、招聘或结局。
